verdict.rationale: Pylon documents an AI Support Agent that deflects customer questions using knowledge-base content, but nothing in the evidence mentions multilingual replies, language detection, or translating answers from an English-only knowledge base. Multilingual support is a fair question for a support platform with an AI agent, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent supports customers in many languages, even where my knowledge base exists only in English
